tagBladeMasteryDESC: The Occultist is able to wield two weapons at once. With lighter blades, the Occultist can attack with greater proficiency and speed. ^y(Swords/Daggers/Axes)
tagCalStrikeDESC: A swift and potent attack that's difficult to avoid and damages the target's ability to retaliate. ^y(Sword/Dagger/Axe/Spear Required)
tagCorneredRageDESC: When overwhelmed in combat, the Hunter goes into a primal rage, fighting with beast-like ferocity at all costs.
tagDRXanatomyDESC: With a deeper understanding of these darker energies, the Occultist is able to channel them in greater quantities.
tagDRXbladehoningDESC: Keeps the Occultist and nearby allies connected to the shadow realm, increasing their energy regeneration and imbuing their weapons with the ability to penetrate deeper and to damage the life of their targets. This connection comes at a cost; the continuous exposure to these energies weakens the user's resistance and slowly drains their life.
tagDRXcalculatedstrike_luckyhitDESC: A swift and potent multi-hit attack. ^y(Sword/Dagger/Axe Required)
tagDRXdisarmtrapsDESC: Years of training allows the Occultist to act deftly in combat and execute maneuvers with speed and precision.
tagDRXlaytrap_petmodifier_multishotboltt: Allows the Occultist to throw a trap that will cloud an area over with a debilitating, impenetrable smoke, making enemies fight less effectively.
tagDRXlethalstrikeDESC: Speed through the shadow realm unseen to deliver an attack with terrifying momentum that will greatly multiply damage and penetration. ^y(All Melee Weapons)
tagDRXlethalstrike_mortalwoundDESC: Shadow energies cling to your weapon as you pass through the shadow realm, greatly increasing bleeding and life damage.
tagDRXopenwoundDESC: The Occultist's weapons are charged with dark energy, greatly increasing the power of their attacks. ^y(All Weapons)
tagDRXpoisongasbomb_shrapnelDESC: Adds dark fragments to the toxic concoction, which explode into a noxious gas, lowering enemy constitution and causing life damage.
tagDarkApertureDESC: The Occultist pries open a wider aperture to the shadow realm, allowing the Darklings to emerge with greater fury and intensity.
tagEnsnareDESC: Casts a weighted net around the feet of enemies, holding them in place but not preventing them from attacking.
tagFlushOutDESC: Draw your enemies out into the open, making them more vulnerable to attack. (Improves the radius and duration of Study Prey)
tagGreaterPowerDESC: Open a direct channel between the shadow stalker and the shadow realm to grant the demon access to its most powerful abilities. ^n^n^yLevel 1: ^cShadow Strike ^w- the Stalker displaces target and himself through the nether, dealing massive damage and paralyzing the enemy.^n^yLevel 6: ^cShadow Rush ^w- a temporary aura that greatly increases the damage and durability of the Stalker and any nearby allies.^n^yLevel 10: ^cShadow Plague ^w- the Stalker infects a target, reducing a portion of its life instantly and slowing it for a few seconds--effect can leap to nearby enemies.^n^yLevel 12: ^cShadow Sprites ^w- the Stalker summons highly unstable shadow sprites in a ring around himself. The sprites' explosion disables monsters.^n^yLevel 16: ^cShadow Bolts ^w- the Stalker assaults a target with bolts of dark energy, dealing damage and paralyzing them momentarily.^n^nThe strength of these abilities is improved as the Shadow Stalker levels up.
tagHerbalistDESC: Living off the land, you learn to identify and utilize medicinal plants to create healing salves or fortify poisons to better assist you.
tagLayTrapDESC: Drop a bolt trap that will trip when enemies draw near, rapidly firing out deadly arrows.
tagMasteryDescription05: The Occultist tempers an assassin's craft with powers drawn from the dark: envenomed blades and flurries of knives for the single kill, and torn-open breaches that grasp, drain, and wither whole packs. Those who walk deepest into the shadow no longer fight alone, for darklings and the shadow stalker answer their call.
tagMasteryDescription06: Master of bow and spear combat.  Piercing attacks penetrate enemy armor and high level bow skills will tear through large groups of enemies.  The Hunter must rely on speed and range to stay out of the reach of enemies.
tagNewSkill321DESC: Infusing the Breach with shadow energy, the Occultist reaches through and grasps enemies, immobilizing them as dark forces sap their life force.
tagOccultMasteryDESC: Provides the physical training and secret knowledge necessary to study the occult.
tagOccultTitleDESC: With cunning, agility, and dark trickery, the Occultist excels at manipulating hordes of enemies and striking from the shadows. Study of the darker arts grants the Occultist access to dangerous energies, which can be used to augment attacks and summon demonic entities.
tagPGBDESC: Adds poison gas pellets to the toxic concoction.
tagScrapDESC: Lobs a bomb that will explode on impact, discharging shrapnel in all directions. With a greater mastery level, you can invest in more lethal ingredients.
tagSkillDescription052: Throw a piercing blade at your opponent capable of causing prolonged bleeding.
tagSkillDescription055: Adds a chance for poison to cloud an enemy's mind, sending them into a state of confusion.
tagSkillDescription056: Learn alchemical processes to distill natural toxins, increasing the potency and duration of all poison attacks.
tagSkillDescription057: Coats your weapons with deadly poison while activated.
tagSkillDescription058: A magician's trick turned to more nefarious purposes, flash powder blinds adjacent enemies impairing their ability to hit with weapons and potentially disorienting them.
tagSkillDescription062: Oils harvested from deadly Nightshade plants give your Envenomed Weapons the ability to slow enemies.
tagSkillDescription076: Imparts the predatory spirit and cunning necessary to learn the arts of hunting.
tagSkillDescription077: Central to survival in the wilderness is the ability to hunt with bow and spear.  Great familiarity with these weapons allows you to wield them with exceptional speed and precision. ^y(Bows/Spears)
tagSkillDescription078: Barbed hooks on the hunter's Ensnare net tear into enemies as they struggle causing them to bleed.
tagSkillDescription079: Those who answer the call of the hunt will fight with increased speed and cunning.
tagSkillDescription082: Modifications to the Bolt Trap increase the number of bolts fired per round.
tagSkillDescription084: Hunting experience gives you the edge when facing familiar quarry such as Animals and Beastmen.
tagSkillDescription087: Expertise in assembling traps reduces the amount of time it takes to create a new trap after one has been set.
tagSkillDescription088: Take full advantage of your enemy's mistakes and vulnerable moments to inflict savage wounds.
tagSkillDescription093: Grants those who follow the hunt endurance to relentlessly track their quarry, preventing even the most tangled thicket from slowing pursuit.
tagSkillDescription094: Making use of available cover as you press your attack allows you to avoid unnecessary damage.
tagSkillDescription095: By observing your prey from a distance you may discover its weakness, resulting in greater pierce damage.
tagSkillDescription143: Learn to throw additional knives at once and cut down enemies with a lethal flurry of razor-sharp metal.
tagSkillDescription169: Marksmanship skill allows you to create and fire arrows that fly faster and increase pierce damage.  {^y}Apply this skill to your left mouse button.
tagSkillDescription170: Incorporating a more streamlined shaft into your arrows allows them to pass through targets and hit additional enemies in their path.
tagSkillDescription171: The power of the Quillvine grove revitalizes those within and reduces the energy consumed by skill use.
tagSkillDescription172: Increased barb growth causes Quillvines to fire multiple barbs on attack.
tagSkillDescription173: A combat technique that uses the spear or bow to rapidly strike three times in succession.
tagStalkerSummonsDESC: Summons a powerful demon to assist the Occultist. Even outside of the shadow realm, the stalker is able to subdue enemies with a barrage of life-damaging attacks. With access to more energy, the demon's full potential can be unleashed.
tagTakeDownDESC: Speed toward enemies and deliver a brutal thrust with your spear. ^y(Spear Required)
tagTempestExposeDESC: With snake-like control of your body, you learn to coil greater tension into your muscles and strike with lethal precision.
tagbreachDESC: The Occultist pries open an aperture to the shadow realm, allowing dark energies to pool more freely.
tagirregulardemonDESC: Through a tenuous opening to the shadow realm, the Occultist can draw out and coalesce darker energies into a shadow demon, a ferocious but difficult to control entity. The binding energies that hold the shadow demon together are fragile, and it's best to be far away should the demon suffer too much damage, or get too close to electrical energy.
